text: Here's why Netflix’s CEO says the company doesn’t need to diversify into new businesses, even as Disney, AT&T, and Facebook try to carve up the streaming market (NFLX, AAPL, FB, GOOGL, DIS) By Troy Wolverton Oct 16, 2018, 9:12 pm 24 pts Netflix faces a host of new rivals in the streaming video business, including Disney. Despite that, the company has no plans to diversify into other business lines, CEO Reed Hastings said.
